protocol.acceptance: All 505 worker executions must finish successfully and exactly match archived uninterrupted suffix rows/final checkpoint in every non-timing field; all source/model/world/input hashes must remain unchanged at end
protocol.cost: Retain each subprocess wall, entry-to-result worker CPU/wall and fresh FullHX setup; Linux RUSAGE_CHILDREN user+system total includes interpreter startup. Parent CPU and total wall separately reported
protocol.environment: Same Linux host, inherited identity/proxy settings; per-worker BLAS/OMP/MKL/NUMEXPR thread count fixed at one; no new training or world generation
protocol.failure_rule: Retain stdout/stderr/returncode/timeout/error and full request/results for every worker; failed/mismatched workers block qualification, none dropped or replaced
protocol.limits: Fresh-process action-boundary restoration only. No interrupted in-flight action, OS power loss, durable exactly-once I/O, Rust ACK, adversarial snapshot corruption, task-benefit or production qualification. Existing worlds reused only for engineering replay; no new independent scientific confirmations
protocol.publication_order: Publish new source/protocol/SOURCE_FREEZE before any worker execution. Do not modify frozen adapter or renewal source
protocol.stage: Independent stacked engineering qualification; existing 40 worlds, 80 episodes, every one of 505 stored action boundaries
protocol.worker: subprocess.run fresh sys.executable -m continuous_cold_replay worker per boundary; reload frozen model and ContentAdapter; restore Owner state/receipts and continuous state/PCG64; execute actual suffix
protocol.worker_information: Own boundary checkpoint, public schedule, explicit opt-in artifact and world directory. Expected suffix/outcomes are retained only by parent comparator, not sent to workers
